overview: The council of Hutt kajidic elders that arbitrates clan disputes, trade routes, and syndicate policy across Nal Hutta and the wider Cartel.
history: Hutt Grand Council governed galactic affairs during the Hutt Cartel. Detailed chronicles, succession rules, and institutional structure will be expanded in a future update.
significance: Hutt Grand Council shaped the political identity of its era and remains a reference point when historians compare later governments across the Star Wars timeline.
notableEvents: Hutt Grand Council established as a governing authority in galactic records
